text:
Emma: FYI we've got a vendor drop-in from Greenfield Labs at ~11:30. They're bringing a wooden crate + a potted plant. Can we arrange staging and a temp badge? :package: :seedling:
Raj: Receiving B has space usually. If heavy, Facilities can help unload. Also we should avoid leaving plants on the high shelf (water risk).
FrontDeskBot: New delivery logged: 1x wooden crate (label: "Greenfield Labs"), 1x potted plant (recipient: Maya). Location: Receiving Rack B. Temp badge color: teal.
Noah: Suggest putting the plant on the low bench by the window. Less tipping risk and easier access for watering. I'll shift my laptop bag if needed.
Maya: That's mine 60a I'll meet them at concierge. Can someone save the sunny couch near the cafe from 11:20-12:00? I want a place to sit with the guest while we sign paperwork.
Emma: Quick poll: react with :thumbsup: to reserve sunny couch 11:20-12:00, :thumbsdown: if you need it.
Liam: :thumbsup:
Raj: :thumbsup:
FrontDeskBot: Visitor checklist: 1) ID scan on arrival; 2) temp badge (teal) printed; 3) visitor log sign; 4) escort to Conference Room 2 or sunny couch. Conference Room 2 status: free 11:30-12:30.
Maya: I grabbed a tarp and cardboard from the supply closet to protect the bench and floor in case of spills. Also found a tote in Mailroom 2 labeled "Greenfield" 4e6 left it near Receiving B.
Emma: Thanks Maya. I'll put a sticky on the crate: "Fragile - plant inside / escort Maya / tarp added" and message Facilities for a hand at 11:15.
Noah: Facilities confirmed ETA 11:10.
Maya: I'll meet them and escort to the couch or CR2 depending on preference. Thanks for saving the couch :heart: 
Emma: FrontDeskBot, please flag the crate as fragile and confirm temp badge color teal in the log.
FrontDeskBot: Done. Crate flagged fragile; temp badge color set to teal; delivery log updated with note: "tarp/cardboard added, escort: Maya".
Raj: Left a small sign on the bench: "Plant staging - please do not move."
Maya: All set. I'll bring the welcome kit and be at concierge by 11:20.
Emma: Appreciate the quick help everyone. Ping here if anything changes.
_meta: watercooler thread coordinating visitor dropoff, badge, seating reservation, and package handling
